trigger: Walt, on the sled, near the end.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Walt rides the sled now. His breath sounds like a valve that won't seat.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Listen. The cards. Rack two, slots four through nine. Sequence matters. Pumps, then fans, then the turbine.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: You know it. You knew it in October. I'm just saying it out loud so I can hear it one more time.

choices.text: Pumps, fans, turbine. I've got it.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Good. Good. You're a good crew chief. I'd have hired you.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Ha. Sure I will. ...No. I won't. That's okay. I got to hear it run once more. That was the deal.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: When you see the steam over the ridge, wake me. I want to see it.
